annotations.title: Compare payer remits to contract rates

description: Compare commercial payer remits to your contract rates and list the underpayments. Send contract_rates (code, optional 2-character modifier, rate per unit in US dollars) and remit_lines (your own line_id, code, optional modifier, units, paid, optional patient_responsibility or the payer's allowed amount). Get back, per line, expected vs actual and the shortfall, totals in cents, the sources (your two lists, with the labels and dates you gave) and a signed record. Free. Arithmetic only: no model, no outside lookup, nothing stored. Up to 200 rates and 200 lines per call. Do NOT send patient names, dates of birth or member, account or record numbers: only your own row numbers as line_id. It does not read contracts, assign codes, or give billing, coding or legal advice, and it cannot say a payer is wrong, only that the numbers differ from the table you supplied.

contract_effective_date.description: Optional date the rates took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), echoed back.

contract_label.description: Optional name of the contract, echoed back as a source.

modifier.description: Optional modifier. A rate with no modifier is the default for the code.

rate.description: Contract allowed amount per unit, US dollars.

remit_label.description: Optional name of the remit batch, echoed back as a source.

allowed.description: The payer's stated allowed amount; if given it is used instead of paid + patient_responsibility.

line_id.description: Your own row label. Not a patient, member, account or record number.

paid.description: Amount the payer paid on the line.

patient_responsibility.description: Copay, coinsurance and deductible on the line. Default 0.

tolerance.description: US dollars per line up to and including which a difference is ignored. Default 1.00, at most 1000.

name: underpayment_audit_compare
